titulo: Reciprocal verbs and the position of the pronoun
subtitulo: Nos abrazamos, se ayudan, vamos a escribirnos.
regla: Reciprocal verbs (each other) use the plural reflexive pronouns nos and se: nos queremos, se ayudan. The pronoun follows the usual position rules. Add el uno al otro or mutuamente to stress it.

bloques.texto: A **reciprocal** action is one that two or more people do **to each other**: _hug each other, help each other, know each other_.
Spanish uses the **plural reflexive pronouns**: **nos** (_we... each other_) and **se** (_they / you all... each other_).
Tip: **nos** and **se** here mean _each other_. If it's only one person, it can't be reciprocal.

lista.en: We hug each other a lot.
Do you and Marta know each other?
The neighbors helped each other when they could.
You write to each other by email, right?

lista.es: Mi hermano y yo ==nos== hablamos todos los días.
lista.en: My brother and I talk to each other every day.

bloques.texto: Same rules as any reflexive pronoun:

lista.texto: In front of the whole phrase or attached: **nos podemos escribir** / **podemos escribirnos**; **se están entendiendo** / **están entendiéndose**. Never in the middle.

lista.es: Podemos escribir==nos== mientras estás en Alemania.
lista.en: We can write to each other while you're in Germany.

lista.es: ==Nos== podemos escribir mientras estás en Alemania.
lista.en: We can write to each other while you're in Germany.
Hug each other, you've made up!

bloques.texto: **Nos** and **se** can also be plain reflexive (_ourselves, themselves_). To make it clear, or for emphasis, add **el uno al otro** (**la una a la otra**, **los unos a los otros**) or **mutuamente**:

lista.en: Julián and Alberto respect each other.

lista.es: Julián y Alberto se respetan ==el uno al otro==.
lista.en: Julián and Alberto respect one another.
Julián and Alberto respect each other mutually.

filas.t: Ellos ayudan el uno al otro.
Ellos se ayudan el uno al otro.

lista.texto: Reflexive verbs: [[5085|reflexive verbs in the present]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _They see each other every Sunday._
Two ways: _We're going to call each other._
lista.r: Nos vamos a llamar. / Vamos a llamarnos.
